status: Post-hoc exploratory extension designed after the Super User confirmation test was exposed; it must not be described as untouched confirmation.
candidate_and_target: Same 24-hour directed-pair candidates and next-24-hour recurrence labels as confirmation_superuser_v1.
splits: Reuse the five expanding temporal folds without changing any boundary. Train uses 6-hour cutoffs; tune, calibration, and test use non-overlapping UTC-midnight cutoffs.
gpu_requirement: CUDA is mandatory. Abort instead of silently falling back to CPU.

ranker.architecture: 78 -> 128 -> 64 -> 1 MLP with LayerNorm, SiLU, and dropout 0.10
ranker.pointwise_loss: Class-weighted binary cross entropy over every training candidate; positive weight capped at 20.
ranker.pairwise_loss: RankNet softplus loss within the same (cutoff, source) group. Each positive is paired with the hardest frequency/recency negative and one random negative when available.
ranker.early_stopping: Tune AP, patience 2; test is never used for stopping.
ranker.mixed_precision: CUDA float16 autocast with gradient scaling

calibration: Logistic calibration and F1 threshold selection use only the calibration interval.
ensemble: Arithmetic mean of the frozen calibrated baseline probability and calibrated CUDA RankNet probability. Its threshold is the arithmetic mean of the two calibration-derived thresholds; no test tuning.
primary_exploratory_question: Does CUDA RankNet improve source-conditional NDCG@5 over the frozen baseline while losing no more than 0.005 overall AP?
success_rule: The paired 7-day block-bootstrap 95% interval for NDCG@5 difference is entirely above zero and pooled AP difference is at least -0.005.
scope_warning: Exploratory extension, not a new confirmatory test and not evidence of causality or SOTA.
